expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Aug28 reference price RMB235.53 implied roughly 27x 2023E and 21x 2024E PE. The auto basket was favorable, but BYD itself remained -5.0pp versus CSI300 over 60d and only recently turned positive over 20d.

expectations.measurableGap: The company has realized earnings growth far above matched peers while its own 60d relative price has not yet completed the same rerating.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward PE plus realized Q2 unit-economics / earnings conversion versus matched OEMs.

expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Export/high-end mix and scale sustain high profit growth through the next reporting cycle.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Earnings must continue to grow materially faster than mature/transition peers; no large multiple expansion is required.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: Volume remains strong but discounting/expenses normalize profit growth toward the market baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Monthly sales/export and Q3 earnings can validate/falsify scale economics inside 60 trading days.
